dataset: Krishnan, Heer, Cherian & Sheffield (2022) 'Reward expectation extinction restructures and degrades CA1 spatial maps through loss of a dopaminergic reward proximity signal' -- published Source Data file (Supplementary MOESM4).
paper_reference: Krishnan S, Heer C, Cherian C, Sheffield MEJ. Reward expectation extinction restructures and degrades CA1 spatial maps through loss of a dopaminergic reward proximity signal. Nat Commun 13, 6662 (2022).
